newsitem.title: USA: Harvey wins deal for 26 more Casper shows.
newsitem.headline: Harvey wins deal for 26 more Casper shows.

text.p: The Harvey Entertainment Co on Monday said it and Universal Cartoon Studios will produce an additional 26 episodes of the hit animated series Casper for the top rated Fox Kid's Network.
Universal Cartoon is a divison of Seagram Co Ltd's entertainment wing, Universal Studios Inc and Fox Kid's Network is a division of News Corp Ltd.

The order for additional shows will bring the total number of Casper episodes to 52 and permit The Fox Kid's Network to keep Casper on Saturday mornings through 1997, while it expands the show to weekday afternoon programming in September.
In addition, Harvey said it and master toy licensee, Trendmasters, will unveil a new Casper toy line at this week's Toy Fair in New York.
